name: The Door
description: A strange, unlocked door in the Ninth District that leads into the House of Duskmourn and vanishes behind whoever enters.

description_citations.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
description_citations.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The reader finds that the focus of the research is just a door.
timeline.quote: It's a door. Just a door.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The reader tries the door and finds it unlocked.
timeline.quote: You try the doorknob. It turns easily.

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | It's a Beautiful Day" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: The door slams shut and vanishes behind the reader in an impossible hallway.
timeline.quote: As you step into the hall, the door slams shut behind you.
